purpose: isolate the utility contribution of observed graph propagation without model selection

fixed_hyperparameters.federated_optimizer: standard FedAvg weighted by labelled local training count

comparison.estimand: observed P minus identity P pooled test metric
comparison.claim_rule: the hierarchical 95% interval for observed-minus-identity pooled Macro-F1 must exclude zero
parameter_matching: identical architecture and trainable parameter count
identical alpha, initialization seed, optimizer, rounds, masks, membership, and FedAvg aggregation
only the polynomial propagation operator changes from observed induced-graph P to I

prohibited_actions: changing alpha after inspecting E19 results
dataset-specific selection between P and I
dropping datasets, client counts, partitions, or seeds after execution
using certificate metrics from the identity control as evidence for the graph certificate
